nextEvents.title: EVENTS
nextEvents.description: YSBR events are not just entertainment: they are experiences to be lived. Moments where sport, music and nature come together, creating real connections between people and places. From festivals to outdoor events, every project is born to empower the community, support the independent scene and experience every space in an active and mindful way. Unique events united by the same energy: sharing, moving, living.

joinUs.title: JOIN THE FAM
joinUs.intro: Becoming a member of the YSBR Fam means being part of a community that shares values, passions and authentic experiences.
joinUs.benefits_intro: Being part of the Fam allows you to:
joinUs.benefit1: · Participate in activities and events reserved for members
joinUs.benefit3: · Contribute to the growth of an independent and authentic community

FAM.title: FAM
FAM.description: YESBRO ASD (YSBR) is an Amateur Sports Association founded in 2022. We combine unconventional sports, music and nature into authentic and inclusive experiences. From snowboarding to kitesurfing, from slacklining to animal flow: moving, discovering and sharing is our mantra. An open, sustainable and mindful community. Make room for adventure. Join the Fam.

SPORT.title: SPORT
SPORT.description: For YSBR, sport is not about performance, but personal and collective expression. We promote outdoor disciplines and sports activities as tools for connection, growth and freedom. Whether on water, land or immersed in nature, sport becomes a way to know yourself, push your limits and share authentic experiences. The level doesn't matter: it's the attitude that counts. Participate, push further, do it together. Sport is our universal language. It's what moves us, always.

MUSICA.title: MUSIC
MUSICA.description: Music is connection, culture, vibration and identity. Through events, DJ sets and sound projects, we create spaces where people can meet, dance and feel part of something unique. YSBR supports the underground and independent scene, empowering artists, crews and communities that share our vision. Every event is an experience: sounds, energy and freedom merging into an unforgettable moment. Music is the heartbeat of our community and what ignites everything else.

NATURA.title: NATURE
NATURA.description: YSBR was born and grows with a deep bond with the environment, the sea, the mountains and open spaces. We believe in an active and mindful lifestyle that respects the land and celebrates its beauty. Because for us, nature is home — a fundamental part of our identity. It's balance, freedom and inspiration. Our outdoor activities are an invitation to slow down, breathe and live authentic experiences, away from the noise.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body:
This website does not directly collect personal data from users through proprietary tracking systems or registration areas.

The association membership form is managed by Cognitoforms, a third-party service subject to its own privacy policy.

The site also provides a "Collaborate" form that lets you send a message (name, email and text) through your own email client: the data entered is sent only via email to the association and is not stored by the site.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site does not use profiling or marketing cookies. Only technical cookies strictly necessary for the hosting server (Aruba S.p.A.) operation may be present. These do not require user consent under Art. 122 of the Italian Privacy Code.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body:
The site uses the following external services:

• Google Fonts — for loading web fonts. Google may collect the user's IP address (Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy)
• Cognitoforms — for the membership registration form
• Instagram and WhatsApp — external links to the association's profiles

sections.title: Server logs
sections.body: The hosting server (Aruba S.p.A.) may automatically collect browsing data such as IP address, date and time of access, and pages visited. This data is processed anonymously and in aggregate form for statistical and security purposes.

sections.title: User rights
sections.body: Under EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR), users have the right to access their personal data, request its rectification or deletion, restrict its processing, and object to its processing. To exercise these rights, please contact the Data Controller at the email address indicated above.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: The Data Controller reserves the right to modify this policy at any time, notifying users on this page.
